notes.title: UPDATE 0.13.2
notes.content:
Hello again!
Thank you for supporting XO-Planets.

If you already created a new file since Update 0.13.0 you don't need to make another one for 0.13.1+

0.13.2
-Difficulty can now be changed anytime
-Added Difficulty stats in Scoring System
-Fixed Suicide Mode. Can no longer Upgrade
-Adjusted Floaties speed
-Removed the Splash Logo

0.13.1
-New Distro Machine Display
-You can now scroll left and right on Distro Machine
-Axe weapons now have two hit boxes(overhead and front)
-Legendary Chest can now be unlocked
-Fixed one of the Legendary Weapon
-Mobs info are color coded and much easier to read
-The Wrath of Azimuth now have secondary attack

0.13.0
-Added Unlockable Intel through Holofeed.
-Unlock the Jukebox after finishing the game once
-Items can now be Salvaged (HOLD INTERACT)

FIXES AND UPDATES
-Drones no longer use collision on terrains
-Razor Drone Now uses Distance Comparison Mechanic between player and enemies
-Player now have to be close to heal drone to benefit from it
-Re-balance Weapon Stats and Drops
-Re-balance Weapons Degradation
-Fixed the LOG again
-Boss knock-back are now limited to Game View+100
-Bosses are seriously dangerous
-Higher Tier Weapons have better Epic Chance
-Higher Tier Weapons Breaks faster
-Optimize Scatterguns Bullets
-Receptacles no longer base on RNG (timing is everything)
-The Abominator no longer spawn stuff
-Leeches now absorbs energy from player when touched
-Jinxters can corrode the players battery and lose some battery max when it explodes on contact
-Back Smokes gain hp from fire elemental weapons
-Pyro multiplies when attacked with fire weapon
-Sputter Bullets are now short range
-Scorpions have high attack damage
-Fixed Alpha on unfreeze state
-Added more notifications on Pickups
-Sonar now displays enemies too
-Replaced FPS with TIS (Time In Service)
-Visor now displays the Planet name
-Improved Solar Regen Batteries
-Slam can now inflict radius damage
-Air Blast can now inflict radius damage and adjusted price accordingly
-Changed Teleport control key to SHIELD+BOMB
-Fixed Objects clipping on explosions
-Crit Damage no longer increase with Level
-Tower Purchase is less sensitive. No more accidental purchase.
-Fixed some overlapping text

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE 0.12.0
notes.content:
[B]REQUIRES NEW SAVE GAME[/B]

-Added NEW 3 different types of Launcher Weapons
-Added Orbs on Wrath of Azimuth
-Added Bricks Excerpts (more to come)
-Added 3 more ranks and badge
-Added Weapons Degrades overtime and can be maintained with Weapons Kit
-Weapon Mods now have more dramatic impact
-Retain Weapons upgrade info even if dropped from inventory
-With Scattershots players can now immediately use melee after firing a shot
-Long Range Weapons now have lower damage
-Blaster Weapons now have at least 1 PIERCE to start
-Dioscuri Unlock Requirement reduced to half
-Fixed the SCORE tab
-Updated some of the Sprites look
-Rocketeer now overheats to prevent being OP
-Jetpack can now exhaust fuel
-Added limit to Slam to prevent spamming

-Fixed Globs not counting kills
-Drones can now be knockedback
-Razor Drone now chases enemies if distant to player
-Paladin Drone now have notification when healing
-Paladin Drones now deploys shield when player is near an enemy
-Paladin Drone uses shield more often
-Drones can now die
-Change EPIC LVL to EPIC CHANCE
-Removed the Tomb on next Level for Coop
-Disables Enemy Spawners during Tower Defense on Pause
-Added Option to Reduce particle dust(Explosion)
-Added Option to Disable Blood Splatters
-Lowered Components drops and value
-Components now Disappears overtime
-Lowered Holofeed distance to disconnect
-Lower the Abominators drops
-Background Colors are lighter on the eyes
-Changed Palette Tone
-Optimized particles and sprite
-Lots of Optimizations
